verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Notte pricing page with a no-card trial and a bring-your-own-keys comparison row. Nothing in the pack shows per-task or per-browser-hour rates, and no rate or concurrency limits are documented. A community user also notes that the pricing page lists credit amounts without saying what a credit buys, so the pricing is not transparent per unit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see transparent per-task or per-browser-hour pricing and documented rate/concurrency limits before committing
